plugins.name: rescribe
plugins.description: Prompt enhancer: a shortcut rewrites the draft in the prompt box, and a menu shows the change to apply or dismiss.

plugins.name: gpu-lock
plugins.description: One CUDA job at a time: GPU commands run under a lock and are checked against free GPU memory first.

plugins.name: correction-ledger
plugins.description: Saves each correction you make as a standing rule, feeds the rules back every turn, and makes a rule louder each time it is broken.

plugins.name: fleet-board
plugins.description: A pane for the other Claude sessions you run: who is working, who went quiet. Brief, ping, task or stop them, and open new sessions from the pane.

plugins.name: smart-comments
plugins.description: Reads each comment Claude adds, lets through the ones that tell a reader what the code cannot, skips docstrings, and names the lines to cut.
